dct_description_sm:
Contains extents of permanent waterbodies located within Peel Region. This dataset includes lakes, ponds, reservoirs, marshes, and drainage/stormwater management ponds. Lakes have a surface area >= 2 hectares, while ponds have a surface area less than 2 hectares, except when the body of water is classified as an industrial waterbody.

The identification and classification system used does not follow the Ontario Wetland Evaluation System (OWES). The dataset was created for the purposes of cartography and is classified accordingly.
